title: Location reference
description: A warehouse location, resolved against the Basetool's location list: first by its starmap GUID, then by its UEX link, then by the exact name. A place without a warehouse location is `LOCATION_UNKNOWN`.

guid.description: The DataForge GUID of the starmap object the location stands for, in lower-case canonical form: the location's own starmap object, else its city's, else its space station's. Absent when none is linked. Wins over `uex` and `name` in a write; an unknown GUID falls back to them.
